english.title: Sporting event - permit carrying alcohol on motor vehicle

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: SPORTING EVENTS CONTROL OF ALCOHOL ETC ACT 1985

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the

(A)_[driver of a motor vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers,]_
(B)_[keeper or servant or agent of the keeper of a motor vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers]_
(C)_[person to whom a vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers has been made available by its keeper or the keeper's agent or servant,]_
(D)_[servant or agent of the person to whom a vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers has been made available by its keeper or the keeper's agent or servant,]_

knowingly permitted intoxicating liquor to be carried on the motor vehicle which was being used for the principal purpose of carrying two or more passengers for the whole or part of a journey to or from a designated sporting event, namely **(..SPECIFY SPORTING EVENT..)
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 1A(2) and 8 of the Sporting Events (Control of Alcohol etc) Act 1985.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: See police power to enter any part of the designated sports ground for the purpose of enforcing the provisions of this Act and police power to stop a public service vehicle, a motor vehicle or a railway passenger vehicle.

other.powersofarrest: A constable may search a person he has reasonable grounds to suspect is committing or has committed an offence under this act, and may arrest such a person.
other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
